The Paper Tiger (The Strategic View)
Over the long term, imperialists and reactionaries
are paper tigers. They are divorced from the
people and historically destined for defeat.
Strategically, we must despise the enemy.
The Iron Tiger (The Tactical View)
In the immediate present, the enemy has real
teeth. They devour people by the millions and
fight desperately. Tactically, we must take them
seriously in every single concrete battle.

The Real Iron Bastion
True defensive power lies not in concrete
fortifications, but in an organized, armed populace.
The revolutionary war is a war of the masses. A true "bastion of
iron" is the millions of people who genuinely support the
revolution. When the population is organized into militias and
guerrilla units alongside a regular army, the enemy becomes
trapped like a "mad bull crashing into a ring of flames."
